items.text: Anyana kaLevi amayala; Gereshoni, Kohati, niMerari.
Anyana kaKohati amayala; Amarama, Izihari, niHeberoni, niUziyeli.
Anyana kaAmarama; Aroni, niMosi, niMiriyami. Anyana kaAroni amayala; Nadabi, niAbihu, Eleyazari, niItamari.
Eleyazari wavweli Fwineha si, Fwinchasi wavweli Abishuwa;
Abishuwa wavweli Buki, Buki wavweli Uzi;
Uzi wavweli Zera hiya, Zera hiya wavweli Merayoti;
Merayotiwavweli Amariya, Amariya wavweli Ahitubi;
Ahitubi wavweli Zadoki, Zadoki wavweli Ahimayazi;
Ahimayazi wavweli Azariya, Azariya wavweli Yohanani;
Yohanani wavweli Azariya, diyi welili mudimu wawupristu mwitala datuŋiliyi Solomoni muYerusalema;
Azariya wavweli Amariya, Amariya wavweli Ahitubi;
Ahitubi wavweli Zadoki, Zadoki wavweli Shalumi;
Shalumi wavweli Hilikiya, Hilikiya wavweli Azariya;
Azariya wavweli Seraya, Seraya wavweli Yehozadaki;
Yehozadaki diyi wayili hafumishiliyi Yehova aYuda nawakwaYerusalema nachikasa chaNebukaneza.
Anyana kaLevi amayala; Gereshomi, Kohati, niMerari.
Majina awanyana kaGereshomi diwu awa; Libini, niShimeyi.
Anyana kaKohati adiŋi niAmarama, nilzihari, niHeberoni, niUziyeli.
Anyana kaMerari; Mahili, niMushi. Yisaka yawaLevi mwahita mavumu awankakulula jawudiyeniyi.
Akudi Gereshomi; Libini mwanindi, Yahati mwanindi, Zima mwanindi;
Yowa mwanindi, Ido mwanindi, Zera mwanindi, Yeya terayi mwanindi.
Anyana kaKohati amayala; Aminadabi mwanindi, Kora mwanindi, Asiri mwanindi;
Elekana mwanindi, niEbiyasafwi mwanindi, niAsiri mwanindi;
Tahati mwanindi, Uriyeli mwanindi, Uziya mwanindi, Shawulu mwanindi.
Anyana kaElekana; Amasayi, niAhimoti.
Akunjikiliyi Davidi mudimu wakutala mudimu wakwimba tumina mwitala daYehova helili chimbaŋu chinanooki dehi, diwu awa.
Hiyakuikalakala natumina kumesu atabanaka yetenti dakubulakena, nichatuŋiliyi Solomoni itala daYehova muYerusalema; hiyakwimena nyidimu yawu mwayile jeluwu mwayilejeluwu.
Emenuku, ni anyanawu amayala, diwu awa; akudi anyana kawaKohati amayala; Hemani mukwakwimba tumina, mwana kaYoweli, Yoweli mwana kaSamweli;
Samweli mwana kaElekana, Elekana mwana kaYerohami, Yerohami mwana kaEliyeli, Eliyeli mwana kaTowa;
Towa mwana kaZufwi, Zufwi mwana kaElekana, Elekana mwana kaMahati, Mahati mwana kaAmasayi;
Amasayi mwana kaElekana, Elekana mwana kaYoweli, Yoweli mwana kaAzariya, Azariya mwana kaZefwaniya;
Zefwaniya mwana kaTahati, Tahati mwana kaAsiri, Asirimwana kaEbiyasafwi, Ebiyasafwi mwana kaKora;
Kora mwana kaIzihari, Izihari mwana kaKohati, Kohati mwana kaLevi, Levi mwana kaIsarela.
Mana kwindi Asafwi diyi wemenaŋa kuchikasa chindi chachidiilu, yowu Asafwi mwana kaBerekiya, Berekiya mwana kaShimeya;
Shimeyamwana kaMikayeli, Mikayeli mwana kaBayasheya, Bayasheya mwana kaMalikiya;
Malikiya mwana kaEtini, Etini mwana kaZera, Zera mwana kaAdaya;
Adaya mwana kaEtani, Etani mwana kaZima, Zima mwana kaShimeyi;
Shimeyi mwana kaYahati, Yahati mwana kaGereshomi, Gereshomi mwana kaLevi.
Kuchikasa chachimunswa kwemenaŋa anakwawu anyana kaMerari; Etani mwana kaKishi, Kishi mwana kaAbidi, Abidi mwana kaMaluki;
Maluki mwana kaHashabiya, Hashabiya mwana kaAmaziya, Amaziya mwana kaHilikiya;
Hilikiya mwana kaAmizi, Amizi mwana kaBani, Bani mwana kaShemeri;
Shemeri mwana kaMahili, Mahili mwana kaMushi, Mushi mwana kaMerari, Merari mwana kaLevi.
Niana kwawu aLevi diwu akunjikiluwu kunyidimu yejima yatabanakayetala daNzambi.

Aroni nawanyanindi amayala diwu ashitilaŋa nyilambu hakameŋa kahimulambu wakushita, niinsensi hakameŋa kakwochela insensi, diwu elilaŋani mudimu wejima wamwamweni mwajila, niwakuyilila aIsarela yakubuta nachu, mwomwayilejeliyi kambuŋa Yehova Mosi mwejima.
Anyana kaAroni amayala diwu awa; Eleyazari mwanindi, Fwineha si mwanindi, Abishuwa mwanindi;
Buki mwanindi, Uzi mwanindi, Zera hiya mwanind i;
Merayoti mwanindi, Amariya mwanindi, Ahitubi mwanindi;
Tiyenu mwashakaminaŋawu mwekalila yilombu yawu muŋinza jawu, mwawanyana kaAroni amayala, mwayisaka yawaKohati, muloŋa diwu adiŋi neseka dawu;
ayinkeli Heberoni wekala mwituŋa daYuda, nimpatajawu janyeŋu mukaku;
ilaŋa maha akumukala owu nitunyikala twawutwanyanya, enkeli mwana kaYefune Kalebi.
Anyana kaAroni ayinkelinyikala yakupulukila, niHeberoni, niLibina nawa, nimpata jawu, niYatiri, niEshetemowa nimpata jayu;
niHileni nimpata jawu, niDebiri nimpatajawu;
niAshani nimpata jawu, niBetishemeshi nimpata jawu;
Yakumuchidi waBenjamini; Geba nimpata jawu, niAlemeti nimpata jawu, niAnatoti nimpata jawu. Nyikala yawu yejima mwahita yisaka yawuyadiŋi nyikala yampwembu ikumi nayisatu.
Anyana kaKohati amayala asheluku ayinkeli nyikala yampwembu ikumi chakuyisakwila nachinjikijilu, kuchisaka chamuchidi, kumuchidiwachibalu, wowu muchidi waManase wachibalu.
Anyana kaGereshomi mwekalila yisaka yawu ayinkeli nyikala yampwembu ikumi nayisatu, nikumuchidi waIsakari, nikumuchidi waAsheri, nikumuchidi waNafwatali, nikumuchidi waManase wamuBashani.
Anyana kaMerari mwomwekalilayisaka yawu ayisakwilili nachinjikijilu nyikala yampwembu ikumi nayiyedi, yakumuchidi waRubeni, niyakumuchidi waGadi, niyakumuchidi waZebuluni.
Anyana kaIsarela enkeli aLevi nyikaloyu yampwembuni mpata jayu.
Nyikaloyu yanatenuwu hamajina ayisakwilili nachinjikijiluni kumuchidi waYuda, nikumuchidi wawanyana kaSimeyona, nikumuchidi wawanyana kaBenjamini.
Yisaka yawanyana kaKohati amayala yi kwawu yadiŋi nanyi kalaya mpwembu yamuŋinza jawu yakutambwila kumuchidi waEfweremi.
Ayinkeli nyikala yakupulukila, niShekemi nimpata jawu mwituŋa daEfweremi damapidi, niGezeri nawa nimpata jawu;
niYokimeyami nimpata jawu, niBetihoroni nimpata jawu;
niAyijiloni nimpata jawu, niGatirimoni nimpata jawu.
Kumuchidi waManase wachibalu, niAneri nimpata jawu, niBileyami nimpata jawu, yachisaka chawanyana kaKohati chasheluku.
Anyana kaGereshomi amayala ayinkeli yakuchisaka chamuchidi waManase wachibalu, niGolani wamuBashani nimpata jawu, niAshataroti nimpata jawu.
Kumuchidi wa Isakari; niKedeshi nimpata jawu, niDaberati nimpata jawu;
niRamoti nimpata jawu, niAnemi nimpatajawu.
Kumuchidi waAsheri; niMashali nimpata jawu, niAbidoni nimpata jawu;
niHukoki nimpata jawu, niRehobi nimpata jawu.
Kumuchidi waNafwatali; niKedeshi wamuŊaliliya nimpata jawu, niHamoni nimpata jawu, niKiriyatayimi nimpata jawu.
Anyana kaMerari amayala asheluku kumuchidi waZebuluni ayinkelukuni Rimoni nimpata jawu, niTabori nimpata jawu.
Nikwishinadi daYodana kwakwihi naYeriku, heshinadi daYodana damusela, kumuchidi waRubeni ayinkeluku niBezeri wamwisaŋa nimpata jawu, niYahaza nimpata jawu;
niKedemoti nimpata jawu, niMefwata nimpata jawu.
Kumuchidi waGadi; niRamoti Gileyadi nimpata jawu, niMahanayimi nimpata jawu;
niHeshiboni nimpata jawu, niYazeri nimpata jawu.
